item.statement: For valid invocations the operator writes exactly the logical width-by-height odata cells; it does not initialize or alter padding columns beyond width and performs no other memory writes.

plans.objective: Verify the write footprint is limited to the logical region.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run on Ascend 950PR, and capture the full odata buffer including padding.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff logical cells match the host oracle bitwise and every padding column (x>=width) remains bitwise equal to the sentinel.
plans.setup: Pre-fill the entire odata buffer, including pitch-width padding columns, with a sentinel bit pattern; launch the candidate with pitch>width; compute host oracle for logical cells only.
